new_value: Implemented SCHC version negotiation protocol: Added spec for Version Query (0x03) and Version Response (0x04) messages under L2 dispatch 0x15 to enable active version negotiation on ad-hoc links. Added Python implementation with SchcVersionQuery/SchcVersionResponse classes, helper functions (create_version_query, handle_version_query, process_version_response), and comprehensive test coverage (34 new tests). Spec updated in 03-adaptation.md section 5.7 and appendix-schc.md.
